lines: (Bruno's voice drops. It goes low and slow and very, very Italian. This only happens when he's stressed.)
Thomebody... put mud pies... in Mrs. Crumb's bakery. And they let my thister take the blame.
You find this other Nina. You tell her... Bruno sends his regards.
(He blinks. His normal voice comes back.) ...Sorry. That just comes out sometimes. Please help Nina.
You sent the other Nina back through the pond? For real?
(The voice creeps in again.) You have done this family... a great favour. One day, I may ask you for a favour in return.
(Normal again.) Probably a skate favour. Like filming me. Not when I fall.
(Bruno nods at you from under his black SK8 beanie.) 'Thup. Bruno. Nina's brother. The little one, but don't thay little.
(He points at the gap in his grin.) Lotht a tooth. On the Big Vert. Totally worth it.
You thkate? Come find me at the Thkate Yard after school. I'll show you thtuff.
...Okay, it'th kind of fun. Don't tell Prue.
(He's lining up the Big Vert.) Watch. And don't film it if I fall.
Okay. Thecret one. Pop the ollie at the very top of the ramp, not before. Patience. Like Mr. Palmer thays. Ugh.
(He drops in, flies up the far side, grabs his board and lands it clean.) ...You thaw that, right? Tell Nina.
My room. Pothterth. Board. Ramp. Mum thays no rampth indoorth. It'th a thmall ramp.
(Mouth full of cereal.) Mm. Nina'th being weird again. Thtaring at the clock like it owes her money.
Recess is the only good part. Juniper keeps trying to interview me. No comment.

rotate: The gap jump? Theven metreth. I've cleared it. Twice. Okay, once and a half.
Nina goes quiet near midnight. Like she's listening for something. Weird, right? ...Right?
Grandma thays my beanie makes me look like I'm about to rob the bakery. It'th a SKATE beanie. It thays SK8 on it.
(He whistles through the gap in his teeth.) The tooth fairy gave me a whole dollar. I'm thaving it for wheelth.
